Plumbing repairs we assess

Leaks, fixtures and visible pipes

Include the fixture type, room and whether the leak is constant or only appears when the tap or appliance is used.

Blocked or slow drains

Slow drainage, gurgling or water returning through another fixture are useful observations. Avoid repeatedly adding chemical drain cleaners.

Running toilets and pressure concerns

Note whether a toilet can still be used, whether water is reaching the floor, and which taps are affected by a pressure change.

Hot-water problems

Share the unit location, symptoms and any visible model information that can be read safely. Do not remove covers or handle wiring.

Before you contact us

  • Property address and suburb
  • Room or area affected
  • When the issue began
  • Whether water is actively leaking
  • Occupant and access details

fragments.before:
What helps with an enquiry

Details worth including

Location

State the property address or suburb, affected room and fixture. For apartments, include the unit number and any access requirements.

What changed

Describe when it began, whether water is active or intermittent, and whether the issue occurs only when a fixture is used.

Safe context

Mention any water near electrical equipment, visible damage or spreading water. Do not investigate a hazard simply to provide more detail.

fragments.before:
A practical booking path

What happens when you get in touch

Describe the issue

Share the property location, what you can see and when it started. Photos are useful only when they can be taken safely.

Confirm property details

We use the address, access contact and service category to arrange an on-site plumbing assessment and confirm the repair plan and written quote.

Keep the request together

For managed properties, add the work order and approval contact so the relevant details travel with the request.

Choose a plumbing service by the symptom

For a slow outlet or wastewater returning through fixtures, start with drainage. Water appearing outside a pipe or fitting belongs with leak assessment; a known damaged pipe belongs with pipe repair. A shower leak may involve plumbing, seals or waterproofing, so the source needs assessment before any repair is agreed. Low pressure at one tap is different from a whole-property supply change. Tell us which outlets are affected rather than assuming that every problem needs pipe replacement.

What does a plumbing quote include?

The written quote identifies the agreed investigation or repair, included materials and relevant access work. The published AUD ranges are guides for standard-hours, standard-scope work, not a fixed quote for an unseen property. Ask which additional work would require further approval.

Can you assess a shower leak or low water pressure?

Describe whether the leak appears during use and which outlets have changed. The assessment separates a plumbing fault from other causes, such as waterproofing or a supply issue. Specialist or additional work is confirmed separately, not assumed from a symptom.

Can you attend immediately or outside standard hours?

Routine service hours: 09:00–21:00, seven days a week. 24-hour emergency repairs are available; call to confirm attendance arrangements and the quoted emergency work. No arrival time is guaranteed. Emergency fees follow the quoted work plan. Utility faults and immediate danger use the appropriate official channel first.

What are your routine hours and emergency arrangements?

Routine service hours: 09:00–21:00, seven days a week. 24-hour emergency repairs are available; call to confirm attendance arrangements and the quoted emergency work. No arrival time is guaranteed. Emergency repair fees follow the quoted work plan. For urgent work, call rather than relying on an online enquiry.

What jobs should I call a licensed plumber for?

Use appropriately authorised plumbing trades for regulated fixed-water and drainage work; confirm the specific task and documentation. Read the explanation.
